fnol_text: My name is Hannah Oyelaran and I live at 550 Kestrel Close, Clinton, NC 28390. You can reach me on (555) 488-3560 or hannah.oyelaran@example.com. There was a flood warning for our area from the day before, but I left the car parked on the street by the river. On 19 November 2025 the water rose and the car was flooded up to the seats. Policy MT-2024-00088. I'd like to claim for the damage to my car.

adjuster_notes.text: Called Dr Oyelaran on (555) 488-3560 to acknowledge the claim. Hannah confirmed the loss date as 19 November 2025.
Vehicle inspected at the repairer. Witness Arjun Ishikawa gave a statement by phone.
Hannah sent photos and a contractor's estimate. Water line visible on walls.
